Strategy: Scale both the sweet-band reward and the mid penalty down to fifteen, testing whether gentler steering still beats Best Fit. This keeps most Best Fit behavior intact, but the smaller adjustments may rarely change any ranking.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (15 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (15 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
